The main takeaway from our work is that
the insights of mysticism, when properly articulated, can provide a powerful impetus to theological reflection and a rich source of new and fresh theological insights.

the trinitarian experience of Elizabeth of the Trinity provides a powerful corrective to the overly individualistic and anthropocentric tendencies of contemporary trinitarian theology, which is in turn a corrective to the overly objective and dehumanizing tendencies of much of modern theology.
